name: Burl’s Gourmet Pork Loin and Twice-Baked Yams
subtitle: From Chef Burl
notes: A friend who cooked an office party dinner for our first Christmas holiday in the new Soulsbyville house—2006. (Gourmet salad and trifle too!)

items: 10 medium-sized scrubbed sweet potatoes or yams

steps.title: Roast the pork
steps.body: Place pork loin on a bed of sliced Granny Smith apples and top with Dijon mustard and fresh thyme. Roast until 165°F inside.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Accompany with sauce made of sautéed chopped onions and apples with butter and cream, lightly sautéed.

steps.title: Bake the yams
steps.body: Bake **10 medium-sized scrubbed sweet potatoes or yams** at 350°F until tender.

steps.title: Sauté the bacon and onion
steps.body: Sauté **½–1 pound bacon**, chopped, and **1 large onion**, chopped.

steps.title: Scoop the potatoes
steps.body: Cook potatoes slightly, then scoop out insides.

steps.title: Whip the filling
steps.body: Whip potato insides, and add **½ cup butter**, sautéed onion and bacon, **¾ cup sour cream** and salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Serve the yams
steps.body: If desired, place back in skins and warm in oven, or simply serve in a tasteful serving bowl.
